hub.welcome.subtitle: Choose a study or create a new one.
access.label: ACCESS

preview.empty: Add a question to see the preview
dashboard.title: Biosignal Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor connected study clients, BrainBit, MR60 BLE, tablet camera emotion, local processing, and XDF readiness.
dashboard.xdfHint: Use LSL timestamps as primary sync layer.
notion.title: Notion Settings
notion.subtitle: Configure the backend-local Notion token, the active study target, and the upload queue without editing raw hardware JSON.
notion.keyLocalHint: The key stays backend-local on this computer, normally in local_secrets.json.
notion.autoRetry: Automatically retry failed uploads on server start
notion.studyValuesHint: These values are saved with the currently loaded study.
notion.uploadThisStudy: Upload results of this study to Notion
notion.parentPageIdPlaceholder: 32 characters from the Notion page URL
notion.parentPageHint: Study Runner creates the participant database under this page when needed.
notion.queueNote: An upload only happens when Notion is globally active and the currently loaded study has Notion enabled too.
notion.guide.step1.title: Create an integration
notion.guide.step1.body: In Notion, under notion.so/profile/integrations, create an internal integration with Read, Update and Insert Content.
notion.guide.step2.title: Save the API key
notion.guide.step2.body: Paste the token into the API key field. The browser never receives saved keys back.
notion.guide.step3.title: Share the page
notion.guide.step3.body: Create a Notion page for StudyRunner data and invite the integration with full access.
notion.guide.step4.title: Set the Parent Page ID
notion.guide.step4.body: Enter the 32 characters from the Notion page URL into the Active Study Target settings.
settings.notionMovedHint: Notion-specific study values are collected on the full Notion settings page.
settings.recordBiosignalsHint: When disabled, this study sends no triggers to external sensors (BrainBit/radar), even if cards request it.
study.done.title: Thank you!
study.done.sub2: You can now put the device down.
